lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat jaaneeai gur mileeai sa(n)k utaar ||
lines.translation: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: muiaa jit ghar jaaeeai tit jeevadiaa mar maar ||
lines.translation: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anahad sabad suhaavane paaeeai gur veechaar ||2||
lines.translation: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad baanee paaeeai tah haumai hoi binaas ||
lines.translation: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur seve aapanaa hau sad kurabaanai taas ||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khaR daragah painaaeeai mukh har naam nivaas ||3||
lines.translation: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rav rahe siv sakatee kaa mel ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: trihu gun ba(n)dhee dehuree jo aaiaa jag so khel ||
lines.translation: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: vijogee dukh vichhuRe manamukh lahahi na mel ||4||
lines.translation: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bairaagee ghar vasai sach bhai raataa hoi ||
lines.translation: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan mahaaras bhogavai baahuR bhookh na hoi ||
lines.translation: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ihu man maar mil bhee phir dukh na hoi ||5||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu mano moorakh lobheeaa lobhe lagaa loubhaan ||
lines.translation: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad na bheejai saakataa duramat aavan jaan ||
lines.translation: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo satagur je milai taa paaeeai gunee nidhaan ||1||
lines.translation: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re haumai chhod gumaan ||
lines.translation: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gur saravar sev too paavahi daragah maan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap dinas raat guramukh har dhan jaan ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh har ras bhogane sa(n)t sabhaa mil giaan ||
lines.translation: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nit ahinis har prabh seviaa satagur deeaa naam ||2||
lines.translation: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kookar kooR kamaaeeai gur ni(n)daa pachai pachaan ||
lines.translation: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharame bhoolaa dukh ghano jam maar karai khulahaan ||
lines.translation: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sukh na paaeeai guramukh sukh subhaan ||3||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai dha(n)dh pitaaeeai sach likhat paravaan ||
lines.translation: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sajan gur sevadaa gur karanee paradhaan ||
lines.translation: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai karam sachai neesaan ||4||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik til piaaraa veesarai rog vadaa man maahi ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu daragah pat paaeeai jaa har na vasai man maahi ||
lines.translation: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai sukh paaeeai agan marai gun maahi ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re ahinis har gun saar ||
lines.translation: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin khin pal naam na veesarai te jan virale sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot milaaeeai suratee surat sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hi(n)saa haumai gat gae naahee sahasaa sog ||
lines.translation: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jis har man vasai tis mele gur sa(n)jog ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kaaman je karee bhoge bhoganahaar ||
lines.translation: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis siu nehu na keejaee jo deesai chalanahaar ||
lines.translation: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ravahi sohaaganee so prabh sej bhataar ||3||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||
